title: KubeCon 2026 - Travel & Expense Admin Scratchpad
content:
MASTER NOTES / SCRATCHPAD - KUBECON 2026

Status: working admin checklist for Redwood booth + team travel reimbursements / vendor contact list. 
Last updated: 2026-02-15 (after vendor call)

Quick agenda:
- Confirm final headcount for booth staff (by 2026-02-20)
- Finalize catering order and dietary restrictions (deadline 2026-02-22)
- Collect all receipts and invoice PDFs for finance (upload to EXP-412)
- Confirm on-site contact numbers + arrival windows

People attending (prelim):
- Lucas Ramirez (PM) - lead contact
- Jordan Kim (Eng) - demo lead
- Olivia Park (Sales) - customer meetings
- Emma Li (Design) - booth materials
- 2 backup on-call (TBD)

Travel / Accommodations notes:
- Flights: booked on United (PNR: RDX123) - receipts emailed to travel@redwood.ai (need PDF receipts)
- Hotel: Harborview Marriott - group block under "Redwood Inference" - check-in 2026-03-10, check-out 2026-03-13
- Per diem guidance: follow company policy (max meal allowance = $70/day domestic). Save detailed receipts for any meal > $25.
- Taxi / rides: prefer rideshare; mark business purpose on receipt. If splitting, include names attending.

Expense reminders (for team):
- Submit expense report within 7 days of return. Finance will reject partial uploads.
- Required attachments: receipts (PDF or photo), boarding passes, hotel folio (showing nights), conference invoice if paid by card.
- Card charges: personal card reimbursements require explanation (why company card not used).
- Currency conversions: attach exchange rate screenshot or use company travel portal conversion.
- Reminder: Uber/Taxi detailed receipt required for reimbursements > $100 (finance policy).

Vendor contacts (calls / emails from 2026-02-14):
- Booth vendor: ExpoBuild Co. 
  - Contact: Maya Torres (maya@expobuild.co) / +1-415-555-1822
  - Contract: Booth #D12, 10x20, basic A/V package included. Need to confirm power drops + carpet color.
  - Action: confirm power drop location by 2026-02-20 (Jordan to ping).
- AV / Monitors: SoundStage AV
  - Contact: Derek Shaw (derek@soundstageav.com) / +1-617-555-9300
  - Deliverables: 2 x 32" monitors, 1 mic (lapel), HDMI adapters (USB-C -> HDMI), spare extension cord
  - Note: request on-site tech presence for first 2 hours of show (9:00–11:00). Confirm by 2026-02-22.
- Catering (foyer demos / staff snacks): BiteRight Catering
  - Contact: Priya Kaur (pri@biteright.co) / +1-212-555-0104
  - Order: morning coffee + pastries (80 pax), boxed lunches for staff day 1 (5 ppl), vegetarian options + two gluten-free
  - Action: collect dietary restrictions from team by 2026-02-21 (Olivia to collect).
- Shipping / Freight: FedFreight (partner)
  - Contact: Ramon Alvarez (ramon@fedfreight.io) / +1-800-555-7777
  - Note: inbound crate ETA 2026-03-09, outbound pickup 2026-03-13 (after show). Need manifest ready by 2026-02-25.

On-site logistics checklist:
- Booth materials: banner (2x), literature rack, 8 swag boxes (t-shirts, stickers), demo laptop + chargers (label everything)
- Power: confirm 2 x 110V outlets + one dedicated 20A (expo vendor to confirm)
- Network: request wired drop for demo laptop; fallback to mobile hotspot (test SIM prior)
- Contact sheet: create printed list with cell numbers for all staff + vendor techs; include emergency contact for venue security
- Demo time slots: block 30-min demos at booth during lunch (12:00 & 12:30 on 03/11) - Jordan to coordinate sign-up sheet

Reimbursements / Finance process (notes for team):
- Use expense template: https://finance.redwood.ai/expense-template (upload final PDF to Jira EXP-412)
- Label receipts: FILE NAME format = "KC26_<lastname>_<type>_<date>" e.g. KC26_Ramirez_flight_2026-03-10.pdf
- For vendor invoices (catering, AV): request PDF invoice with tax ID; forward to procurement@redwood.ai for PO matching
- If you paid with company card, add memo with purpose and project code: PROJ-KC26

Open questions / TODOs:
- Who is taking care of swag customs form? (Lucas to check with procurement)
- Confirm Marriott late checkout for Emma (needs to stay for teardown) - check by 2026-02-28
- Final headcount for offsite dinner on 03/10 (budget = $1,200) - Olivia to confirm restaurant and guest list
- Are we allowed to ship extra demo units? Need explicit sign-off from SRE for network exposure (Jordan/Eng)

Notes to self (messy):
- Remember to upload credit card receipts to Exp-412 before leaving. Finance hates missing folios.
- Print extra business cards (50) and label the box "Lucas - KC26" so we don't lose it in shipping.
- Bring HDMI + USB-C dongles + small ethernet adapter. Put spares in Emma's backpack.

Meeting notes from vendor call (2026-02-14):
- ExpoBuild: power drop location might shift; they will send updated floorplan Friday (2026-02-20).
- SoundStage: can provide on-site tech for first day at +$250; recommend we take it to avoid delays.
- BiteRight: can add vegan boxed lunches but need final counts by 2026-02-22.

Links / references I keep using:
- Confluence: KubeCon logistics page (KC-Logistics)
- Jira: EXP-412 (expenses), LOG-77 (shipping manifest)
- Slack: #events-kubecon pinned messages

Random reminders:
- Double-check visa requirements for any international team (not relevant for current list, but remember for EU attendees)
- If refunds happen (flight change), annotate refund amount in the expense report and attach airline confirmation email

END OF SCRATCHPAD

(Will clean up into a formal checklist for ops handoff next week)
